rows.what: Owned RM_ biome, positive animal/plant density, fungal forage, natural terrains, disease/weather pools and map content; standalone identity and composed Baroque Biomes member.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef registration, composed Biomes member, vanilla map terrain/plant/animal/weather readers
rows.why: Designer decision. Ordinary pale fungal ground, natural density, sky and map terrain form the place. Weather hazards and special content are separately disposed.

rows.what: BiomeWorker and tunable cold/dry/elevation scoring are still compiled; spontaneous planetary placement is code present, outside the standing no-worldgen scope.
rows.called_by: RM_TheRot_Biome.xml workerClass and RM_TheRotBiomeRanges extension, RM_TheRotKernel biome score, proof worker
rows.why: Designer decision. Recommend retiring automated planetary placement under the standing worldgen ban. It is permanently out of scope, including the next version. Preserve reference-compatible inert stubs if needed.

rows.what: Sheen-fall, tempest and mist retain wet-weather fire effects; Clear and DryThunderstorm remain in the rotation. Falling moisture is described as fungal emission.
rows.called_by: RM_TheRot_Biome.xml baseWeatherCommonalities, vanilla WeatherDecider
rows.why: Designer decision. The standing no-water-rain rule requires emission weather. Deleting its wet reskin would make this world display ordinary water rain. Infection behavior moves separately.

rows.what: Permanent condition bootstraps coating; weather/roof-gated ladder decays under shelter, gear slows gain, symbiosis stops it, saturation can seed spore flesh.
rows.called_by: RM_SheenExposureLock.xml biomeMapConditions, EnvironmentalWeather bootstrap, RM_HediffComp_SheenExposure
rows.why: Designer decision. A coating-to-infection hazard is an independent survival system. Wet emission land and metabolism function without it.

rows.what: Owned human and animal allergy incidents/diseases, also used by Contagion; separate from Sheen coating. Rot front gates incidence.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef disease pool, RM_SporeAllergyIncidents and TheRotFront sporeAllergy gate
rows.why: Designer decision. Random allergy duplicates a second spore illness beside the exposure ladder. Recommend retirement of the Rot-owned incidence as redundant illness pressure. Shared Contagion consumers retain ownership.

rows.what: Exposed rottables/corpses get extra temperature-dependent RotProgress; enclosed rooms exempt; frozen objects receive no extra progress.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_AcceleratedRotExtension, RM_MapComponent_AcceleratedRot.MapComponentTick, RM_KitFronts
rows.why: Designer decision. Keep the kit’s temperature-scaled digestion for exposed stores and corpses, with vanilla preservation for frozen stores at Frostcaps and for walled and roofed storage. T67 verifies this contract. Q1 asks whether to extend digestion through freezing.

rows.what: Exposed filth thins probabilistically on the same sweep, leaving indoor cleaning to ordinary play.
rows.called_by: RM_MapComponent_AcceleratedRot.MapComponentTick calls ThinOutdoorFilth after AccelerateRot
rows.why: Designer decision. Random outdoor filth thinning is a separate cleanup convenience. Food spoilage and corpse staging already show exposed decay, and storage and shelter decisions work with ordinary filth handling.
rows.needed_by: none, food and corpse stages make exposure readable

rows.what: Natural mycotic ground and listed mat floors warm qualifying enclosed rooms using ordinary room heat; floor fraction, offset and 21 C ceiling bound help in the cold.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_WarmGroundExtension and RM_MapComponent_WarmGround.MapComponentTick through RM_KitFronts
rows.why: Designer decision. A colony benefits from metabolic warmth by enclosing living floor. Removing warmth leaves the signature with costs alone. No feed/upkeep inside Rot.

rows.what: Stored Rot-native fungal food from ordinary forage and crops pushes heat into its room wherever the item is stored. Native harvests currently yielding RawFungus need a Rot-owned marked equivalent. Vanilla RawFungus stays inert.
rows.called_by: RM_MapComponent_LivingProduce scans spawned things for RM_LivingProduceExtension. No XML binding found anywhere under src by exact search in this checkout
rows.why: Designer decision. The colony's usual fungal diet must create the freezer decision. Binding only glimmerslime and dulcis lets a colony storing ordinary RawFungus-yielding forage bypass it. The engine exists and T66 covers the missing content binding.

rows.what: Brewing vessel, ingredient/work/research costs, live ingredients and live-prep markers; cold ruin plus lifespan, strict/lenient temperature option retaining expiry. The minimal vessel, crown ingredient and viability path used by pleasure_brew is retained under T7; the wider preparation suite remains deferred.
rows.called_by: BrewingVessel recipeUsers, live-prep RecipeDefs, TemperatureRuinable and Lifespan, RM_Patch_LivePrepViability
rows.why: Designer decision. The defended medicine expedition has its own production and expiry loop. Ordinary food and metabolic shelter work without its vessel or clock. T7 isolates the owner-marked pleasure cup support from this deferred suite.

rows.what: Age-reversal cup configured for five biological years, adult floor and once-per-year saturation; scarce grove ingredients gate production.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_AgelessBrew -> RM_Tea_AgeReversal ingestion doer -> age and saturation hediff
rows.why: Designer decision. Age reversal adds an expedition reward and dosing system beyond ordinary life and metabolism. Existing potency/annual-limit rulings bind its next-version design.

rows.what: Temporary bioregeneration hediff heals old wounds and boosts natural healing.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_RegenerantBrew -> RM_Tea_Bioregeneration -> RM_Bioregenerating healer comp
rows.why: Designer decision. Permanent-injury healing is a special medical reward. It is unnecessary to the retained food/shelter chain.

rows.what: Guarded Lussa crown brewed on its harvest day and consumed on-site gives chemical joy and a timed positive memory.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_EuphoricBrew -> RM_Tea_Pleasure -> chemical joy and RM_EuphoricBrewMemory
rows.why: Owner mark of 2026-11-17 in owner_marks.md retains the Lussa crown cup, chemical joy and timed positive memory in 0.1.0.

rows.what: Permanent fast-healing symbiont paired with increased hunger, live before ingestion.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_QuickfleshSymbiont -> ingestible -> RM_Sym_Quickflesh stages
rows.why: Designer decision. Healing/appetite symbiosis is a separate permanent bodily bargain.

rows.what: Sleep suppression paired with increased mental-break threshold and periodic mental-state risks.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_NightwakeSymbiont -> ingestible -> RM_Sym_Nightwake stages
rows.why: Designer decision. Sleep/mental-state symbiosis is a separate permanent bodily bargain.

rows.what: Ingested symbiont grants Sheen immunity plus sunlight-scald stages; ordinary sun/shade systems own the surrounding environment.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_SheenbloodSymbiont -> RM_Sym_Sheenblood sunlight comp and Sheen compatibility
rows.why: Designer decision. Immunity/sun intolerance is an extra bodily bargain coupled to deferred Sheen exposure. Its sun rule must keep the shared geometry.

rows.what: Mycoid resistance marker symbiont and toxic injection, with recipes and viability; the receiving Slime mod owns their anti-absorption effect.
rows.called_by: RM_Brew_MycoidSymbiont / RM_Brew_ToxicInjection, ingestibles and receiving Slime consumers recorded historically, receiving source unavailable here
rows.why: Designer decision. Slime resistance and injection serve a neighboring biome encounter. They add a separate export chain.

rows.what: Selling marked Rot treasures gives a memory to colony symbiont hosts; culture starters are a distinct portable exception.
rows.called_by: RM_TreasureMarkerExtension on ingredients/preparations, RM_Patch_TreasureSaleConscience trade hook
rows.why: Designer decision. Trade guilt depends on special symbionts and treasures. With those deferred the retained economy has no host requiring this event.

rows.what: RM_AgelessCap (orlath cap) gas emitter
rows.called_by: RM_AgelessCap CompActiveGasEmitter in GuardianGroves.xml, normal map plant ticking
rows.why: Designer decision. This row covers the ageless-cap prize defense only. Removing the special prize grove loses no ordinary food or metabolic shelter. Resident Prime/Skulltop defense remains in its own life row.

rows.what: Mirrash veil damage and false-fruit collection ring a network alarm routed through CreatureBehaviors reactions to tagged defenders.
rows.called_by: RM_RegenerantVeil damage callback, RM_FalseFruit PlantCollected -> RM_CompPlantAlarm.TriggerAlarm -> reaction responder tags on native races
rows.why: Designer decision. Summoned defenders for special live-prize groves add a separate expedition encounter.

rows.what: Pekk fruit has a custom collection trap, alarm and mat-grip lookup; lussa crown and false fruit are separately weighted wild plants. Guarded Lussa crown acquisition for pleasure_brew uses T7's local spore defense.
rows.called_by: RM_FalseFruit thingClass RM_Plant_FalseFruit.PlantCollected -> RUT_MatGrip lookup and TriggerAlarm, BiomeDef independent spawn weight
rows.why: Designer decision. Custom lure/trap/ring is a special-prize encounter mechanic beyond ordinary predation.

rows.what: Wounds mirror within RotSwarm or RotAgarikin cliques, wild and tame, with a severity gate and matching body-part paths; different tags do not mix.
rows.called_by: RM_AgariPorts.xml, RM_Chittik.xml wound link comps and tags -> CreatureBehaviors damage callback. TheRotFront.StripRotKinWiring when off
rows.why: Designer decision. Damage redistribution is the runner-up signature. It creates an independent herd combat loop.

rows.what: Body-size-proportional healing among sufficient same-tag kin: agarikin, wildkin and plobbum broodmates; LeaningScrub owns durrok/mullgoth bodies.
rows.called_by: RM_KinMendingNetwork hediff grants on Agari/Grellik, RotSpecies_WoundSharing.xml for external Durrok/Mullgoth -> CreatureBehaviors kin radius check
rows.why: Designer decision. Kin healing completes the runner-up herd signature. The retained fauna still feed, reproduce and yield ordinary products without it.

rows.what: Owned native hybrid fauna, art/name/size bindings and supporting bodies, eggs, products, sounds and damage. Wild thozzik/queens vent tox gas, skerrith has toxin attacks, brogg milk, agarikin reproduction/harvested products, plobbum eggs and shambles melee.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef wildAnimals plus PawnKindDefs -> vanilla spawning, feeding, predation, taming, products and lifecycle comps
rows.why: Designer decision. The ordinary hybrid food web supplies grazers, predators and tame products. Deleting feeding, hunting, venom/gas combat, milk/eggs or asexual reproduction defeats those ordinary ecological roles. Kin and implantation move separately.

rows.what: Chittik attacks can implant a tendable infection; severe infected-host death spawns hostile chittiks, blood and sound, stripping corpse gear before corpse destruction; mechs/ghouls reject it.
rows.called_by: RM_Chittik.xml claw damage/implant hediff -> RM_HediffComp_SpawnOnDeath on severe infected host death
rows.why: Designer decision. Host implantation and death spawning add a secondary disease/population loop. Chittik ordinary small-prey hunting remains.

rows.what: Dustveil flight stats, eggs, larval metamorphosis, textile feeding and moth-silk product; illoth and thozzik queen flight configuration. No new flight test performed.
rows.called_by: RM_Dustveil.xml adult eggs -> larva metamorphosis -> adult; textile-eating ThinkTree and product comp. Illoth and thozzik flight stats in Fauna races
rows.why: Designer decision. Dustveil textile feeding, egg/larva/adult lifecycle and silk are its ordinary husbandry role. Removing these leaves a decorative moth. Fictional flyers need functional flight by standing ruling.

rows.what: Ordinary fungal forage, timber, fibre and fungal medicine harvest, excluding separately listed special rewards
rows.called_by: BiomeDef wildPlants -> vanilla Plant growth/PlantCollected -> ordinary food, timber, fibre and fungal medicine defs
rows.why: Designer decision. Ordinary forage, timber, fibre and fungal medicine make a local economy. Deleting harvest defeats it. Excludes blast weapons/fuel, ambrosyx intoxication, special live-ingredient prizes and pale-tree powers.

rows.what: Cave-plant bases and donor-port base explicitly set both minimum and optimal glow to zero, repairing sunless growth eligibility without making a new growth engine.
rows.called_by: RM_CavePlantBase/RM_CaveTreeBase and RM_TheRotPortedCavePlantBase inherited by fungal flora -> vanilla Plant tick
rows.why: Designer decision. Deleting sunless growth and cold survival makes the fungal forest die on its own authored night-side maps. Needed by land and life, regardless of a static growMinGlow field.

rows.what: Explicit plant selectability, lowered ground-cover treatment, retired cartoon-variant hash guard and painted variant assets; existing owner keeps remain.
rows.called_by: Selectable fields, RotSpecies_NamesAndSizes.xml, glower comps, selftest_rot_plant_selectable.py and cartoon retirement hash guard
rows.why: Designer decision. Deleting selectability and readable low moss/standing caps makes forage and large contacts unidentifiable. Existing owner-kept art remains authoritative. Variant counts remain checks.

rows.what: TheRot supplies measured contact masks and size bindings to HugeThings for solid ground contacts, open caps and selection; HugeThings owns the common engine.
rows.called_by: RotGiants_HugeFootprint.xml -> HugeThings extensions, plant placement, pathing and selection
rows.why: Designer decision. HugeThings supplies ground-contact collision, whole-picture selection and safe growth placement. Dense giants are ruled and retained. No thinning to fix engine performance.

rows.what: Quellan tree uses vanilla natural meditation, lumma moss and a two-level psylink list; scream/thought on destruction and selection. Franchise wording belongs in campaign patch.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_PaleTree -> vanilla meditation/subplants/Psylinkable, moss, destruction sound/thought, TheRotFront spawn gate
rows.why: Designer decision. Meditation, psylink progression and sacred-grove destruction thoughts are a separate psychic system. Existing cap and declined whitelist remain binding if enabled later.

rows.what: Mushroom logs/leather/chitin/cloth products, biological goo lights, ordinary floors, carpet and bridges
rows.called_by: Ordinary plant/animal products -> mushroom leather recipe, mushroom floor/bridges/matting/carpet, goo torches and RM_AdvancedFungi research
rows.why: Designer decision. Local timber/leather/fibre floors and bridges make land buildable and ordinary harvest usable. Goo lights are required to work in biological darkness. Fungiponics and medicine manufacturing are separately deferred.

rows.what: Cultivated thurrom hearth and finite-life grown furnace
rows.called_by: RM_FurnaceCap harvest -> RM_LivingFurnaceCap -> RM_GrownFurnace heat/lifespan. Furnaceblood GeneDef has comfort offset
rows.why: Designer decision. This original row is narrowed to grown furnace cultivation. Portable heater manufacture adds a replacement/lifespan loop beyond the native floor/harvest chain. Gene is split below.

rows.what: Thrumbungus thrown toxic-spore weapon
rows.called_by: RM_ThrumbungusShroom projectile, RM_BlastpodShroom harvest -> RM_BlastSpore explosive projectile and RM_Make_ChemfuelFromBlastSpore
rows.why: Designer decision. This original row is narrowed to the lobbed thrumbungus weapon. Weapon crafting is independent of ordinary life. Blast fuel and protection apparel split below.

rows.what: Regional suffocating cloud uses EnvironmentalWeather, flesh/roof filters, density changes and weighted incident. The incident explicitly excludes RM_TheRot itself.
rows.called_by: RM_SporeCloud IncidentDef and condition extension -> EnvironmentalWeather, explicitly disallowed in RM_TheRot
rows.why: Designer decision. The regional export incident has a separate suffocation/density loop and explicitly excludes Rot maps. It cannot be a home-biome signature.

rows.what: Hwelgrue custom open-ground item/corpse grazing, bespoke cap and first-sighting letter
rows.called_by: RM_Hwelgrue.xml Animal_PreWander splice -> RM_JobGiver_GutGraze -> RM_JobDriver_GutGraze -> RM_CompGutDigest.Digest. Body accounted separately
rows.why: Designer decision. This row is narrowed to custom item/corpse grazing and bespoke first-sighting/cap behavior. Body and vanilla diet remain. Removing arbitrary-item digestion leaves an ordinary giant animal in the food web.

rows.what: Metal-bearing things and corpse gear retained whole in saved gut, ordinary organics consumed; timed/death castings crack to return full-HP items, quality unchanged.
rows.called_by: RM_CompGutDigest.CompTick / Notify_Killed -> PassCasting / MakeCasting -> RM_CompSheenCasting and Crack open use effect
rows.why: Designer decision. Metal recovery and quality/HP restoration are a salvage economy. Ordinary native fauna and metabolic colony life require no gut inventory.

rows.what: Stationary, upright hwelgrue accelerates nearby rottables using temperature-dependent rot; it does not currently mark warm ground.
rows.called_by: RM_CompGutDigest.CompTick stationary test -> AccelerateRotAround -> RM_TheRotKernel.RotBoost
rows.why: Designer decision. Recommend retiring the extra local rot aura because the map signature already performs decomposition. It adds a concealed overlapping radius without a distinct colony experience.

rows.what: Downed-first graze takes one exposed pawn into a saved holder; inspect names it/time left; damage, downing, death or destruction can release it with earned acid; timeout kills and sorts remains; strangers may already be inside.
rows.called_by: GutGraze job giver checks downed first -> GutSwallow job driver -> Swallow. CompTick timeout, damage/downed/killed/PostDestroy release
rows.why: Designer decision. Live swallowing, timed rescue and preloaded strangers form a separate encounter system. Ordinary giant diet needs none of it.

rows.what: Positional scheduled knocking stages or animal scrabbling diminish with remaining time; core ping/chirp pitch follows integrity. Existing audio uses borrowed vanilla clips.
rows.called_by: RM_CompGutSwallow.Knock scheduled by kernel and swallowed-core Ping/Chirp. Body ordinary calls are separately retained
rows.why: Designer decision. Urgency knocking and drive-core pings explain deferred encounters. Ordinary native calls remain with fauna.

rows.what: World-unique carrier/spent ledger, campaign tile restriction hook, stale-carrier reclamation preserving integrity, reappearing old-carrier demotion and no second death drop.
rows.called_by: RM_CompSwallowedCore.CompTick -> TryClaim, world component ledger; campaignTile extension hook
rows.why: Designer decision. The unique carrier ledger is part of the deferred ship treasure encounter.

rows.what: Ship-mounted-building damage lowers integrity; death yields minified core or ruin; linked core multiplies total engine range by configured bonus times integrity, ruin smelts as salvage.
rows.called_by: RM_CompSwallowedCore damage/death -> drop, RM_SwallowedCore_Gravship.xml -> RM_StatPart_SwallowedCore -> RangeFactor
rows.why: Designer decision. Ship weapon damage and engine-range reward are a second transport system beyond the biome.

rows.what: Engine-presence ping and saved schedule; fixed authored log advances at pings-per-entry, reveals salvage quests, last camp can reward a minified mat root, carrier death ends unread log.
rows.called_by: RM_CompSwallowedCore.Ping -> RM_NavigatorLog.Notify_Ping -> ReadEntry/TryRevealSite -> last camp minified RM_LivingMatRoot reward
rows.why: Designer decision. The log, salvage itinerary and last-camp reward are quests beyond ordinary land and life.

rows.what: Death sac, analysis-gated research and grown vat buildable using sac or starter on other maps.
rows.called_by: RM_CompGutDigest.Notify_Killed -> RM_GutMother.DropSac -> CompAnalyzableUnlockResearch -> RM_GutMotherCulture -> vat build
rows.why: Designer decision. Study-sac research and growing a vat introduce a separate technology unlock.

rows.what: One corpse at a time through work bills; raw-food fuel, fed digestion, hungry dormancy; returns spawnThingOnRemoved implants and gear with first-recovery letter.
rows.called_by: RM_FeedGutMother bill -> RecipeWorker_RM_FeedGutMother -> RM_CompGutMotherDigest.TryAccept / CompTickRare / Finish
rows.why: Designer decision. Implant recovery is a secondary corpse-processing economy.

rows.what: Nutrition/time split makes tradeable non-rotting starter, temporarily resting the vat; portable culture exception has independent value setting.
rows.called_by: RM_SplitGutMother bill -> Notify_Split, starter used in build costs, ApplyStarterValue on startup/settings save
rows.why: Designer decision. Starter splitting/trading adds a portable production economy.

rows.what: Drug-lab research/recipe, list/extension-driven parasite and symbiont purge, husks, sickness and optional organ scar; forces vanilla metalhorror emergence.
rows.called_by: Drug-lab recipe -> RecipeWorker_RM_UnjoiningDraught -> IngestionOutcomeDoer_RM_Unjoining -> RM_Unjoining.Purge. Rite call exists only as source commentary here
rows.why: Designer decision. Parasite purge, metalhorror emergence and organ scars are a separate medical interaction. No deferred symbiont is needed by the retained signature.

rows.what: Minifiable quest reward grows mat while fed raw food off Rot, stops heating when hungry and later uncovers its recorded grown cells; food-free within Rot. Reinstall resets growth tracking.
rows.called_by: Navigator last camp reward -> minify/install -> RM_LivingMatRoot.CompTickRare -> spread/starvation, with terrain ownership state
rows.why: Designer decision. Earned portable floor spread and starvation are an export/reward system. Native floor remains free inside Rot under the later ruling.

rows.what: Qualifying fed mat rooms warm with bounded ordinary heat, no second push from roots in one interval, no duplicate biome push; well-fed clocks bud roots with food cost and installed/minified map cap.
rows.called_by: RM_LivingMatRoot.CompTickRare -> room heat and bud clock, Root counting includes installed and minified forms
rows.why: Designer decision. Portable heat and budding add portable upkeep and reproduction. They retain the ruled food, Rot exemption and travel semantics for the next version.

rows.what: Persisted master/features/tuning, searchable collapsible groups/reset, explicit restart gates for roster/kin, immediate shared-kit fronts. Existing cross-biome opt-in is off and labelled unsupported; portable mat has its explicit supported exception.
rows.called_by: RM_TheRotMod -> ExposeData/settings drawer -> RM_TheRotFront -> shared RM_KitFronts and direct local readers
rows.why: Designer decision. Standing settings ruling requires defaults, master/per-major-feature on/off, clear restart scope and reset. Without it the first version cannot ship.

rows.what: Digested wreck hull/frame field and ordinary salvage adapter
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.extraGenSteps -> RM_WreckField_TheRot -> Wreckage RM_GenStep_WreckField and weathering. Acoustic adapter accounted separately
rows.why: Designer decision. Passive digested wreck hull/frame terrain content uses the universally commissioned Wreckage engine and its salvage. Deleting the adapter defeats the standing wreckage-everywhere integration. Scanner is a separate dependency.

rows.what: Moldy-environment mutator/condition and outdoor mood penalty
rows.called_by: TileMutatorDefs chance fields/extraGenSteps/additionalGameConditions -> Prime scatter, mold mood worker, collector place worker and powered spawner
rows.why: Designer decision. This original row is narrowed to moldy-environment mood. Recommend retiring it because a flat outdoors penalty duplicates the named hostile-spore experience and adds no distinct decision. Other mutators split below.

rows.what: Historical campaign canon-roster and FungalSoilTrade neighbor integrations, absent from this checkout
rows.called_by: Historical record cast_source reports WildAnimals_TheRot patch and FungalSoilTrade. Paths named there are absent from this checkout. No current caller verified
rows.why: Designer decision. Campaign tier owns canon additions and soil-trade behavior, without any roster eviction or new Rot mechanic. Current adapter availability is unknown, historical names preserved for integration checking.

rows.what: Functional suite/driver plan, live helpers, static/mocked/planted checks, pure kernel/fuzz projects, selection/glower/donor-name/dustveil/live-prep/cartoon checks.
rows.called_by: validation.py suite/ northstar_plan.py driver, Tools selftests, RM_TheRotKernel and TheRotFuzz; not player-triggered
rows.why: Designer decision. Existing kernel/fuzz/static/suite tools are regression instruments. They are reused where credible. Most retained map_mechanics readings are currently UNMEASURED.

rows.what: Hwelgrue body, ordinary diet, movement and retaliation
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_Hwelgrue -> PawnKindDef, ordinary animal think tree and race foodType
rows.serves: Hwelgrue body, ordinary diet, movement and retaliation
rows.why: Designer decision. Roster eviction is stopped. Removing body/diet would evict a native. Retain animal and vanilla sustenance while decoupling all special gut jobs, cap deletion and rewards.

rows.what: Prime and Skulltop proximity spore defense as resident predatory fungi
rows.called_by: RM_AgariluxPrime and RM_Skulltop gas comps -> EnvironmentalHazards CompActiveGasEmitter
rows.serves: Prime and Skulltop proximity spore defense as resident predatory fungi
rows.why: Designer decision. Life includes dangerous fungal food patches. Removing their defense turns the owner-celebrated predatory Prime and defensive Skulltop into safe edible scenery, defeating that ecological role. No special tea prize is attached.

rows.what: Furnaceblood comfort-range gene
rows.called_by: GeneDef enumeration, gene acquisition and pawn comfort stat
rows.why: Designer decision. A gene acquisition reward is independent of fungal land, ordinary life and storage metabolism.

rows.what: Wild-only blastpod sac, explosive use and chemfuel recipe
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_BlastpodShroom -> RM_BlastSpore -> projectile / RM_Make_ChemfuelFromBlastSpore
rows.serves: Wild-only blastpod sac, explosive use and chemfuel recipe
rows.why: Designer decision. Explosive harvest and refining form a separate fuel/weapon economy. Keep the wild-only restriction whenever enabled.

rows.what: Chitin helmet with Sheen protection stat
rows.called_by: Apparel stat RM_SheenProtection -> shared exposure / hazard-apparel scorer
rows.serves: Chitin helmet with Sheen protection stat
rows.why: Designer decision. Special protective equipment is useful to the deferred coating hazard. Ordinary vanilla armor remains available for native fights.

rows.what: Ambrosyx intoxicant and source plant serving Slime dish
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_AmbrosyxFungus -> RM_AmbrosyxShroom -> drug and external dish consumer
rows.serves: Ambrosyx intoxicant and source plant serving Slime dish
rows.why: Designer decision. An ambrosia-like drug and neighbor export are a separate experience beyond basic forage.

rows.what: Powered fungal hydroponic basin
rows.called_by: RM_AdvancedFungi/Hydroponics research -> build menu -> Building_PlantGrower default RM_DulcisPlant
rows.why: Designer decision. Recommend retiring the duplicate hydroponic bench. Ordinary sowable fungi and vanilla controlled-growing infrastructure already supply the named cultivation experience.

rows.what: Industrial medicine recipe from fungal medicine
rows.called_by: RM_IndustrialMedicineFromFungal RecipeDef -> worktable bills
rows.serves: Industrial medicine recipe from fungal medicine
rows.why: Designer decision. Ordinary harvested fungal medicine already supplies life. Industrial conversion adds an independent manufacturing shortcut.

rows.what: Cave-spider-head decorative trophy item
rows.called_by: ThingDef RM_CaveSpiderHead and style comp. No local yield or recipe caller located in TheRot defs
rows.why: Designer decision. Recommend retiring decorative loot with no confirmed local source or named first-version experience.

rows.what: Shared Acoustic Scanner payload for ordinary Rot residents, wrecks and hollows
rows.called_by: FindMod guarded payload extension -> AcousticScanner pulses
rows.serves: Shared Acoustic Scanner payload for ordinary Rot residents, wrecks and hollows
rows.why: Designer decision. The patch records the owner commissioning a payload on every biome. Retain integration, changing deferred gut-ring wording to an ordinary body reading. Deleting it defeats that shared contract.

rows.what: Wayward Prime sprout on authored non-Rot tile
rows.called_by: RM_AgariluxPrimeSprout TileMutatorDef -> RM_GenStep_AgariluxPrimeSprout scatter
rows.serves: Wayward Prime sprout on authored non-Rot tile
rows.why: Designer decision. An out-of-biome special encounter is independent of living in Rot. Automatic planetary chance is permanently forbidden and has its own retirement ticket.

rows.what: Edible airborne microfungi marker and powered food collector
rows.called_by: RM_EdibleAirborneMicrofungi tile flag -> RM_MycoticCollector place worker -> powered CompSpawner
rows.serves: Edible airborne microfungi marker and powered food collector
rows.why: Designer decision. Recommend retiring the passive food machine. Fungal forage already supplies food and vanilla hydroponics supplies powered production. Automatic placement chance is forbidden.

rows.what: Milky pond substrate with native drinking and bridge affordances
rows.called_by: Promised by biome and marsh-fungus descriptions. Present callers reference WaterMarshy/MarshySoil, no verified milk terrain
rows.serves: Milky pond substrate with native drinking and bridge affordances
rows.why: Designer decision. The sheet and current descriptions require visible fungal milk ponds. No dedicated substrate/generation binding found by milk/milky search of src and parsing Rot terrains. Ordinary marsh references alone cannot establish it.

rows.what: Biological light from moss, fungi, illoth and goo lamps
rows.called_by: Plant/fauna glower comps and harvested goo -> lamp refueling
rows.serves: Biological light from moss, fungi, illoth and goo lamps
rows.why: Designer decision. Deleting useful biological light makes the ruled dark forest unworkable. Light pools preserve night between caps.

rows.what: CreatureBehaviors ordinary product/lifecycle support and guarded-off kin/alarm extensions
rows.called_by: Rot fauna comps and tags, per-biome front stripping
rows.serves: CreatureBehaviors ordinary product/lifecycle support and guarded-off kin/alarm extensions
rows.why: Designer decision. Keep engine references and ordinary creature services. Deferred Rot-tag behavior must be dormant without stripping other biome tags or evicting creatures.

rows.what: EnvironmentalHazards room heat, rot, living produce, gas and shared settings front
rows.called_by: BiomeDef extensions, RM_TheRotFront RM_KitFronts, native gas comps
rows.serves: EnvironmentalHazards room heat, rot, living produce, gas and shared settings front
rows.why: Designer decision. Needs bounded ordinary room heat, exposed organic digestion, living-produce heat and native plant gas. Require those contracts through existing APIs, with no shared-engine redesign.

rows.what: ExplosiveGrowth wet-native lifecycle for existing Rot flora
rows.called_by: Shared roster and wetNativeBiomes -> ExplosiveGrowthAPI / map component
rows.serves: ExplosiveGrowth wet-native lifecycle for existing Rot flora
rows.why: Designer decision. Owner-ruled wet-native enrollment, Churn and immortal exceptions must operate with the signature. Needs the existing water/soak and lifecycle behavior. Do not invent a Rot spread engine.

rows.what: Wreckage shared placement, decay and salvage
rows.called_by: RM_WreckField_TheRot and RM_WreckWeathering on hull/frame
rows.serves: Wreckage shared placement, decay and salvage
rows.why: Designer decision. Needs ordinary Rot wreck field, salvage and weathering under the common engine. No special loot quest added.

rows.what: Bones shared corpse-butchery products
rows.called_by: Pawn.ButcherProducts shared patch -> Bones kernel
rows.why: Designer decision. Needs ordinary race-appropriate butchery products conserved through corpse hauling and decomposition. Its Insectoid exclusion remains engine-owned.

rows.what: Vanilla Expanded Framework animal reproduction, products, weird eating and metamorphosis
rows.called_by: VEF.AnimalBehaviours comp classes on Dustveil and Agari
rows.serves: Vanilla Expanded Framework animal reproduction, products, weird eating and metamorphosis
rows.why: Designer decision. Ordinary native lifecycles and moth husbandry depend on VEF classes already referenced. No new VEF behavior is designed.

rows.what: Named delicacies and lavish-meal/trade multipliers
rows.called_by: Promised by sheet section 7, no complete named gourmet recipe line located here
rows.why: Designer decision. Cuisine/trade rewards add a separate economy beyond staple forage. Brogg ordinary milk remains.

rows.what: Heat-emitting gene body beyond existing Furnaceblood comfort offset
rows.called_by: Promised by kit M3, current GeneDef supplies comfort offset only
rows.serves: Heat-emitting gene body beyond existing Furnaceblood comfort offset
rows.why: Designer decision. Already explicitly deferred by kit. A biological gene heat source adds a separate acquisition reward.

rows.what: Unjoining discovery/ritual and Wildsteam sacred-grove faction wiring
rows.called_by: Historical rite caller comment in RM_Unjoining.cs, no local ritual/discovery implementation located
rows.serves: Unjoining discovery/ritual and Wildsteam sacred-grove faction wiring
rows.why: Designer decision. Rituals are already tabled by owner. Sacred faction hooks and pilgrimage dressing are extras. Preserve that deferral.

rows.what: Found brewing shrines, pilgrim paths and digestion-site genepack ruins
rows.called_by: Sheet section 8 and kit boundary, no Rot set-piece binding located
rows.serves: Found brewing shrines, pilgrim paths and digestion-site genepack ruins
rows.why: Designer decision. Kit already defers map set-pieces. They add special encounters beyond ordinary wrecks and the chosen signature.

rows.what: Hwelgrue warm-ground trail while resting
rows.called_by: Promised in giant design, RM_Hwelgrue.cs header states no warm-ground marking
rows.why: Designer decision. A moving heat aura/trail adds a second room-heat geometry. Source explicitly records the missing warm-ground API. Ordinary giant and static mat remain.

rows.what: Automatic planetary chance fields on retained-mutator ports
rows.called_by: TileMutatorDef chanceOnNonLandmarkTile fields consumed by planetary selection
rows.serves: Automatic planetary chance fields on retained-mutator ports
rows.why: Designer decision. Standing worldgen ban is absolute. Disable automatic placement permanently, retaining reference-compatible defs for authored save content. No next-version permission exists.

rows.what: Locally beneficial gene treasure for heat, Sheen compatibility and hybrid vigor
rows.called_by: Sheet section 7 Local genepacks and digestion-site promises. Furnaceblood def exists, complete acquisition/source chain not located
rows.why: Designer decision. Gene acquisition and treasure sites add an independent expedition economy. Preserve locally-beneficial-only admission and Slime reservation of general gene archive.

rows.what: Thozzik native faction affiliation and inert raid support defs
rows.called_by: RM_Thozzik and RM_ThozzikQueen PawnKindDefs defaultFactionType -> RM_Thozziks. FactionDef raidsForbidden true and canStageAttacks false
rows.serves: Existing native animal allegiance and hostility
rows.why: Designer decision. Removing affiliation breaks existing native PawnKind default references and their ordinary hostility. Preserve reference-compatible affiliation while blocking new planetary faction creation and raids. Raid loot maker is inert reference support.

rows.what: Protective false-fruit placement around euphoric crown prizes
rows.called_by: Promised in kit M6 and GuardianGroves descriptions. Current biome has independent crown/false-fruit weights, no paired ring placement caller located
rows.serves: Deferred defended crown encounter; ordinary crown harvest for pleasure_brew is retained under T7
rows.why: Designer decision. A guaranteed lure arrangement belongs to the deferred special-prize encounter. Random independent plants establish no guarded ring. It adds no ordinary land/life or metabolic shelter behavior.
